scenes.title: Contacts, travellers and documents
scenes.subtitle: One clean record for every customer
scenes.narration: Your customers, their travellers and their paperwork, kept together in one clean record.
Every customer and agent in one searchable list. Tag contacts the way you work, then filter by tag in a click.
Add a contact with a phone picker that knows the country code. If the email or phone is already on file, the form warns you before you save.
The profile shows every lead, quote, invoice and message for this customer, with a timeline of everything that happened, and the birthdays and anniversaries worth remembering.
Marketing consent is recorded on the contact, with when and how it was given, so campaigns only reach people who said yes.
Rohit was entered twice. Merge the two records: the history comes together and the extra copy leaves the list.
Need a field we did not think of, like a frequent flyer number? Add your own custom fields to contacts.
Moving from spreadsheets? Import your contacts, and export them any time.
Travellers hold passport details and expiry dates, linked to the customer who books for them, so the right names go on every ticket.
Passport copies, tickets and supplier confirmations live in the document library, stored safely and attached to the right booking.

scenes.headline: Every customer, one clean record.
